title.en: Fable 11 — The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A mouse from the city came to visit the country.
He ate dry bread and seeds.
He said: come with me to the city.

sentences.ar: בעיר היה אוכל טוב על השולחן.
sentences.en: In the city there was good food on the table.
There were cheese, meat and cake.
Suddenly a big dog came in.
The two mice ran away fast.
Bread in quiet is better than meat in fear.
